lines.text: Meet DevTree. Git, with a retro soul.
See your entire history at a glance. Every branch gets its own color, every merge its own curve, and it stays smooth even with thirty thousand commits.
lines.caption: See your entire history at a glance. Every branch gets its own color, every merge its own curve, and it stays smooth even with 30,000 commits.

lines.text: Commit exactly what you mean. Click the lines you want, stage just those, and leave the rest for later.
Merge conflict? Don't panic. Compare both sides, then keep yours, take theirs, or keep both, in one click.
Tidy up before you push. Reorder, reword, squash or drop commits, just by dragging them into place.
And it's tiny. About three megabytes, with no Electron, no account and no tracking. It runs on Windows, Mac and Linux, and it's open source.
lines.caption: And it's tiny. About 3 MB, with no Electron, no account and no tracking. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and it's open source.

lines.text: DevTree. Free and open source. Download it today.
